name: admin-proposals-settings
title: admin-proposals-settings
description: admin-proposals's section of the Settings dialog: The gate of the agent's changes to itself: its pull requests from pikit/self/* listed in the dashboard, with their diff and checks, approved (merged) or rejected there with a token the agent never holds; and the project's CI workflow. Dormant until connected, after deploying: the repository from the dashboard's Settings, the two tokens as secrets. Its settings come with the component (pikit add admin-proposals), stored by settings-store.
